name: OWASP Machine Learning Security Top 10
source_notes: IDs, names and draft status verified on the owasp.org ML Security Top 10 project page.
caveats: The project states the current version is a draft that is modified frequently.
No release date found; no post-2023 edition found.
Summaries paraphrase the item names only; prevention text was not captured in the notes.
Maturity 'lab' comes from the OWASP project catalog (level 3; label inferred).
Only ML06:2023 is plausibly statically detectable in app repos (inference).

items.name: Input Manipulation Attack
items.summary: Inputs are deliberately crafted to make the model produce wrong results (e.g. adversarial examples).

review: Model/training-pipeline concern; generally not visible in an app repo

items.name: Data Poisoning Attack
items.summary: Training data is manipulated so the model learns attacker-chosen behavior.

review: Model/training-pipeline concern; generally not visible in an app repo

items.name: Model Inversion Attack
items.summary: Model outputs are used to reconstruct sensitive information about training data.

review: Model/training-pipeline concern; generally not visible in an app repo

items.name: Membership Inference Attack
items.summary: An attacker infers whether specific records were part of the training data.

review: Model/training-pipeline concern; generally not visible in an app repo

items.name: Model Theft
items.summary: The model or its parameters are copied or extracted without authorization.

review: Model/training-pipeline concern; generally not visible in an app repo

items.name: AI Supply Chain Attacks
items.summary: Compromised third-party models, libraries or data in the ML pipeline affect the system.

static: trust_remote_code=True, torch.load / pickle.load of downloaded models, or unpinned Hugging Face model revisions

items.name: Transfer Learning Attack
items.summary: A pre-trained model is manipulated so that the weakness carries into models fine-tuned from it.

review: Model/training-pipeline concern; generally not visible in an app repo

items.name: Model Skewing
items.summary: Feedback or training data distribution is skewed to bias the model's behavior.

review: Model/training-pipeline concern; generally not visible in an app repo

items.name: Output Integrity Attack
items.summary: Model outputs are tampered with between the model and their consumer.

review: Model/training-pipeline concern; generally not visible in an app repo

items.name: Model Poisoning
items.summary: Model parameters themselves are manipulated to alter behavior.

review: Model/training-pipeline concern; generally not visible in an app repo
